Police seized suspected counterfeit and illicit goods worth about R1.05 million from several shops in the town centre this week.

The operation was carried out under search warrants by the local police station, a provincial crime intelligence team and a counter-narcotics unit.

Clothing, shoes and cigarettes were removed from the shops. Police said no arrests had been made and that the investigation was continuing.
